extName.message: Scouty B2B Prospector - Lead Research & Outreach Coach

extDescription.message: Research B2B leads you choose on a social network and get a step-by-step outreach plan in Scouty. Never posts or messages for you.

permissionBody.message: Scouty only opens the profiles you choose to capture.

signedOutBody.message: Sign in, or create an account, to capture profiles.

notOnProfileBody.message: Then click the Scouty icon again.

consentPoint1.message: Scouty reads this profile and the person's recent posts, comments and reactions.

consentPoint2.message: It only presses "see more" and "show more results" to read in full. It never likes, comments, connects, messages or posts for you.

consentPoint3.message: The person may see that you viewed their profile. This site may not allow tools like this and may limit your account.

readingTrust.message: Scouty never posts or messages for you.

sendingSlow.message: Still sending, so keep this browser open.

partialStopped.message: You stopped early, so some parts are missing.

partialSignedOut.message: The connection ended, so some parts are missing.

partialShortened.message: Some long posts weren't opened in full.

linkedinSignInBody.message: Sign in on this site, then try again.

leftPageBody.message: Open the profile again and press Capture.

verificationTitle.message: This site wants to check it's you

verificationBody.message: Finish the site's check, then wait a while before trying again.

unavailableBody.message: This site isn't showing the full profile.

addressChangedBody.message: Capture it from its new page.

offlineBody.message: Scouty will finish once you're back online.

notAnsweringBody.message: Scouty will keep trying to send your capture.

notAnsweringStartBody.message: Please try again in a moment.

connectionEndedBody.message: Do it in the next few minutes to save what was already read.

outdatedBody.message: This version is too old to capture.

notAvailableBody.message: Capture isn't on for your account.

suppressedBody.message: Scouty doesn't keep data about this person.

takenOverBody.message: It was restarted elsewhere or removed in Scouty.

expiredBody.message: It took too long, so nothing was saved.

captureNeedsProfile.message: Open a lead's profile in this tab first.
